title: Hacker News (write tools)
description: Comment, vote, and submit on Hacker News as the logged-in user — the write side HN's official read-only API has never offered. Tokens (hmac, vote auth, fnid) are extracted from HN's own HTML pages; a page-shape change fails loudly. Requires an active news.ycombinator.com login session.
changelog: Initial version: hn_comment, hn_vote, hn_submit. First package to use HTML `pattern` token extraction and `form`/`query` sendAs targets.

tools.name: hn_comment
tools.description: Post a comment on a Hacker News story, or reply to a comment, as the logged-in user. The item ID is the number in /item?id=... URLs. A successful post returns the thread page HTML.

itemId.description: Numeric ID of the story or comment to reply to, from /item?id=...

text.description: Comment body (plain text; blank lines split paragraphs, links auto-link)

tools.name: hn_vote
tools.description: Upvote (or retract an upvote on) a Hacker News story or comment, as the logged-in user. The item ID is the number in /item?id=... URLs. Fails loudly if the item is not votable (own post, expired, logged out).

itemId.description: Numeric ID of the story or comment to vote on, from /item?id=...

how.description: up = upvote, un = retract a previous upvote

tools.name: hn_submit
tools.description: Submit a new story to Hacker News as the logged-in user: a link post (title + url) or a text post like Ask HN (title + text). Provide exactly one of url or text. Duplicate URLs are resubmitted to the existing thread by HN.

url.description: Link to submit; omit for a text post. Provide exactly one of url or text

text.description: Body for a text post (Ask HN etc.); omit for a link post. Provide exactly one of url or text
